name: Occidental-Seif
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around acid rain regions, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.

For traders, copper, geothermal energy and dark crystals alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
